title: Bulbasaur 001/165 SV2a Pokemon 151 Japanese Reverse Holo Poke Ball Lot of 2

descriptionText:
Bulbasaur (フシギダネ) – Pokemon Card 151 – 001/165 – Reverse Holo – LOT OF 2
You will receive both cards pictured – two copies of the same card. Japanese release. Photos are of the actual cards, not stock images.
Card details (each card)
Name: Bulbasaur / フシギダネ (Basic, Grass)
70 HP
Set: Pokemon Card 151 (SV2a), 2023
Card number: 001/165
Rarity: Common – Poke Ball Reverse Holo
Illustrator: Yuu Nishida
National Pokedex No. 0001 – Seed Pokemon
Height: 0.7m  Weight: 6.9kg
Language: Japanese
Copyright: © 2023 Pokemon / Nintendo / Creatures / GAME FREAK
Attack
Leech Seed / やどりぎのタネ (Grass, Colorless) – 20 damage. Heal 20 damage from this Pokemon.
Weakness: Fire ×2. Resistance: none. Retreat cost: 2.
Note on the variant: these are the Poke Ball reverse holo pattern, not the Master Ball pattern. The Master Ball version is a separate, much scarcer variant – please check the photos to confirm which one you are buying.
Condition: Ungraded, in the condition shown. Please review the photos closely and judge for yourself – the images are of the actual cards and are the most accurate description of their condition.
